description: The courses, PHS3288 and PHS3289, are part of the UROPS program in Faculty of Science to provide students with the unique opportunity to gain research experience via hands-on project work under the mentorship of faculty members and research staff. The UROPS experience allows students to pursue research to address real-world problems in the pharmaceutical setting, and to enhance their creative thinking as well as communication and presentation skills. Such experience prepares students for future careers in the pharmaceutical sector and for postgraduate training. This is a UROPS course enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must not have completed 1 of PHS3289/PR2288/PR2289/PR3288/PR3289 at a grade of at least D AND must not be undertaking 1 of 1004PRHON Bachelor of Science (Pharmacy) (Hons), 1004PRMHON Bachelor of Pharmacy (Hons) AND must not be in one of the cohorts prior to 2020 inclusive )

prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must have completed PHS2191 at a grade of at least D AND the student must have achieved a GPA of 3.00 or greater)
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES PHS2191:D AND GPA (3.00))
